Web search results for query: "new AI model released this week October 13-18 2026"

Links: [{"title":"New AI Models — October 2026 LLM Releases","url":"https://llmgateway.io/timeline"},{"title":"AI Model Release Tracker: New AI Models, October 2026","url":"https://opper.ai/model-releases"},{"title":"Alice AI (AI model family)","url":"https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alice_AI_(AI_model_family)"},{"title":"Kimi (chatbot)","url":"https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kimi_(chatbot)"},{"title":"LTX (text-to-video model)","url":"https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/LTX_(text-to-video_model)"},{"title":"ChatGPT","url":"https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ChatGPT"},{"title":"2023 in artificial intelligence","url":"https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_in_artificial_intelligence"},{"title":"DeepSeek Unveils Updated AI Model to Challenge OpenAI and Anthropic - Bloomberg","url":"https://bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-17/deepseek-pushes-out-updated-ai-model-it-says-is-faster-leaner"},{"title":"AI News Today, October 17: Top Stories","url":"https://aiweekly.co/ai-news-today"}]

Several new models came out in the October 13–18 window, though the sources disagree on the full list.

**Most recent releases:**
- **DeepSeek V4.1-Flash-1017 (Oct 17):** DeepSeek posted this model to Hugging Face under an MIT license. It is a sparse-MoE agent model with 552B total parameters that activates 8B on input and 16B on output and supports a 1M-token context. Bloomberg reports that the company said the update had "stronger benchmark performance, faster task completion, and shorter outputs than the previous version." It is live across the web, on DeepSeek's app and its platform for developers.
- **Beam (Reflection AI, Oct 16):** Reflection released this model under an Apache 2.0 license. It is a 501B-total, 23B-active MoE aimed at coding, agents, science and math. The company says it hits ~80% on Terminal-Bench 2.1 while spending ~25,000 tokens per attempt.
- **Glimpse (Elorian, Oct 16):** This is a visual reasoning model that keeps looking back at the source image mid-reasoning rather than tokenizing it once.
- **Grok Voice 3.0 (xAI, Oct 14):** Listed by LLM Gateway as a flagship release from that date.

**Other releases in or near the window:**
- **Muse Wonder 1.0 (Meta, Oct 12)** and **Muse Spark Open (Meta, Oct 15)**, per the Opper tracker.
- **Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B and Nemotron 3.5 Super VL (NVIDIA, Oct 15)**, per the Opper tracker.
- **MAI-Base-2 (Microsoft AI):** A 2.8-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts foundation model with 80B active parameters, trained on 50T tokens. The source doesn't give a release date, so I can't confirm it falls in this window.
- **FLUX 3 Image Klein (Black Forest Labs):** An image model that keeps the larger FLUX 3 line's native 4K generation, bounding boxes and pixel-perfect editing. No date was given.

**Caveats:** These come from aggregator trackers and a news roundup, not official announcements, and the dates and details vary between them. I didn't verify any of them against the labs' own posts. Check the official blogs or Hugging Face pages before relying on specifics like parameter counts or benchmark scores.

content.text:
Estos son los tres lanzamientos que considero más importantes entre el 11 y el 18 de octubre de 2026. Para elegirlos tuve en cuenta la cobertura en prensa y el tamaño del modelo; no hay un ranking oficial.

1. **Meta Muse Spark Open (15 oct.):** Meta lanzó el que llama su modelo de pesos abiertos más potente hecho en EE. UU., con 816.000 millones de parámetros y una ventana de contexto de 1 millón de tokens, pensado para programación y tareas de agentes, y que puede ejecutarse en Macs con Apple silicon. Fuente: [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/15/meta-launches-an-open-weight-model-that-runs-on-macs/)

2. **DeepSeek V4.1-Flash-1017 (17 oct.):** DeepSeek publicó con licencia MIT una actualización de su modelo de agente de tipo MoE (552.000 millones de parámetros en total y contexto de 1 millón de tokens), que según la empresa es más rápida, rinde mejor en los benchmarks y da respuestas más cortas que la versión anterior. Fuente: [Bloomberg](https://bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-17/deepseek-pushes-out-updated-ai-model-it-says-is-faster-leaner)

3. **Reflection AI Beam (16 oct.):** Reflection AI lanzó con licencia Apache 2.0 un modelo MoE de 501.000 millones de parámetros (23.000 millones activos) para programación, agentes, ciencia y matemáticas, y dice que alcanza cerca del 80 % en Terminal-Bench 2.1. Fuente: [AI Weekly](https://aiweekly.co/ai-news-today)

Las cifras de Beam vienen de un resumen de noticias y no las comprobé en el anuncio de Reflection AI.

Otros lanzamientos de la semana que quedaron fuera son Grok Voice 3.0 de xAI (14 oct.) y Nemotron 3.5 de NVIDIA (15 oct.), según los rastreadores [LLM Gateway](https://llmgateway.io/timeline) y [Opper](https://opper.ai/model-releases).
